patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Kaspr and Reply.io share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Kaspr only if your buying job matches “LinkedIn-centric EU/EMEA B2B contact capture (Chrome) — Free plan; Starter from $49/mo ann” rather than Reply.io's shape. Choose Reply.io only if your buying job matches “AI sales engagement platform for multichannel outbound across email, LinkedIn, calls, SMS,” rather than Kaspr's shape. Workflow advantage: Kaspr leans data-enrichment, lead-management; Reply.io leans sales-engagement, email-outreach. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Kaspr and Reply.io share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

- Workflow coverage skew: Kaspr-leaning data-enrichment, lead-management vs Reply.io-leaning sales-engagement, email-outreach.
- Researched limits: Kaspr — LinkedIn-centric capture — coverage and compliance depend on LinkedIn workflow policies; Reply.io — none listed.
